LESSON: DECIMALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.3 Fractions (9 lessons) • Comparing fractions • Operations on fraction
Topic 1.4: Decimals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Decimals. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the place value and the total value of digits in decimals in real-life
2. multiply decimals by a whole number and by a decimal in real-life situations
3. divide decimals by a whole number and by a decimal in real-life situations
4. recognise the use of decimals in real-life situations

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: DECIMALS
Decimals is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Decimals problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Decimals question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Decimals question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Decimals set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Decimals.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Decimals in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the place value and the total value of digits in decimals in real-life
2. multiply decimals by a whole number and by a decimal in real-life situations
3. divide decimals by a whole number and by a decimal in real-life situations
4. recognise the use of decimals in real-life situations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
